about: Pacing targets agreed 2026-10-09 (REDESIGN-PLAN.md section 3), per player in a 1v1. Ranges are [min, max]; null = no bound. combatAlive is combatBuilt x the player style's measured survival at 10:00. A T2 rush is allowed but should be overrun: fastestT2Factory is the earliest T2 factory any opening reaches (seconds), rushFacing (25: about what kills a lone commander, from its health and DPS against T1 tanks) the combat units a factory-spamming opponent has alive at that moment (2026-10-09 reading of "nobody really goes T2 before ~7 min because they'd be overrun").
